issues.jp_before: 日本[にほん]に{行[い]ったら|cd-tara}、まず京都[きょうと]を見[み]たいです。
issues.problem: Distractor 行くなら is natural ('if I go to Japan, I want to see Kyoto first') with essentially the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced 行くなら with 行くので; rewrote why.

issues.jp_before: 荷物[にもつ]が{届[とど]いたら|cd-tara}、お知[し]らせします。
issues.problem: Distractor 届くと is acceptable as a procedural/general statement ('when goods arrive, we notify you').
issues.action: Made it a one-off personal promise: すぐにお知らせしますね; English updated.

issues.jp_before: 子[こ]どもが{寝[ね]たら|cd-tara}、ゆっくりテレビを見[み]ます。
issues.problem: Distractor 寝ると is natural as a habitual reading ('when the kids go to sleep I watch TV').
issues.action: Rewrote as tonight's plan with 見ようと思います so と is excluded; English updated.

issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]が{止[や]んだら|cd-tara}、散歩[さんぽ]に行[い]きましょう。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 散歩しませんか item.
issues.action: Main clause changed to 出かけましょう; English updated.

issues.jp_before: 雪[ゆき]が{降[ふ]ったら|cd-tara}、スキーに行[い]こう。
issues.problem: Distractor 降るなら is natural with the same English; 降れば is equally natural (non-volitional subject) and was missing as an alternative.
issues.action: Added 降れば as alternative; replaced 降るなら with 降るので; rewrote why.

issues.jp_before: 時間[じかん]が{できたら|cd-tara}、連絡[れんらく]します。
issues.problem: Distractor できるなら ('if I can find time') is close to the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced with できるので; rewrote why.

issues.jp_before: 窓[まど]を{開[あ]けたら|cd-tara}どうですか。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 窓を開けたら discovery item.
issues.action: Rewrote as 暑いなら、エアコンをつけたらどうですか with matching distractors and English.

issues.jp_before: 電車[でんしゃ]が{遅[おく]れたら|cd-tara}、先[さき]に始[はじ]めていてください。
issues.problem: Distractor 遅れるなら ('if my train is going to be late, start first') is fully natural with the same English.
issues.action: Replaced with 遅れるので; rewrote why.

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]で{会[あ]ったら|cd-tara}、一緒[いっしょ]に行[い]きましょう。
issues.problem: Distractor 会うなら is natural ('if we are meeting at the station, let's go together').
issues.action: Replaced with 会うので; rewrote why.
